title: Summer Days Remembered
subtitle: 80 Easy Large Print Word Searches About Picnics, Camping, Fishing, County Fairs, and Family Vacations
welcome:
Summer can mean a familiar outing, a new destination, or a comfortable day at home. These puzzles range from backyard games to scenic drives and include different ways to enjoy the season. They are inspired by everyday summer experiences, primarily from the 1950s through the 1970s, without assuming every reader spent summer the same way.

Each page has twelve words and an optional prompt. Reflect, imagine, share a thought, or move on to the next puzzle.
closing: A summer day can be full of activity or wonderfully quiet. We hope these puzzles offered a comfortable change of pace and a few ideas to enjoy in any season.
